xdriven.body: Our software factory. Coding agents take each ticket to production with tests, a preview, a review and a guarded deploy. It builds and deploys itself every day, and our own products run on it. Built for technical founders who work with agents; the studio uses it to build, rescue and run apps for those who can't.

chat.body: Your mail as chats: everyone you write to is one conversation over your whole history, with newsletters and notifications kept apart. We use it in-house every day; it is built and runs on xdriven, our software factory.

muzio.body: A social music app: upload your tracks, share playlists with friends and mix live with a built-in two-deck DJ mode, on the web or Android. It is built and runs on xdriven, our software factory.

missionfit.body: IT freelance missions, driven from your AI: track each mission, tailor your CV with an AI that makes nothing up and follow every application, in the app or from Claude, ChatGPT and Le Chat. Recruiters run their missions and candidates in it too. It is built and runs on xdriven, our software factory.

polysee.body: One workspace for software delivery: connect GitHub or GitLab to see your delivery metrics, write docs together and coordinate your team and its AI agents, without switching tools. It is built and runs on xdriven, our software factory.

specjest.body: A command-line tool that turns Gherkin .feature files into Jest test skeletons, and back, so specs and tests stay in step.

cloviz.body: A local dashboard for your Claude Code sessions: costs, activity over time, and full session replay. Your data stays on your machine.

localvoice.body: Voice chat with a language model that runs entirely on a laptop: nothing leaves the machine. It can also join a video call as a voice assistant.
